EmailTemplate.subject: REMINDER: New Client Dashboard
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
[Virtual Q&A]
New Improved Client Dashboard Same information. Enhanced functionality. More intuitive design. We hope you’ve been enjoying using the new dashboard over the past few months. We’ve been hard at work gathering feedback and making improvements to make it the best experience possible. If you haven’t already, please log in <[[https://dashboard-new.flywire.com/login?fromOldApp=true?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> to the new dashboard to access all of your cross-border international payment information.
Please note that effective June 2nd, the former dashboard will be retired, and all users will be required to use the new dashboard. To aid this transition, we have changed the link in your daily disbursement emails to point directly to the new dashboard.
Learn more about the new dashboard here <[[https://dashboard-new.flywire.com/learn-more?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, and join one of our virtual Q&A sessions to get all your dashboard questions answered!
- Session 1 <[[https://more.flywire.com/NewClientDashboard-QASession.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>: May 19th at 8am PDT | 11am EDT | 4pm BST
- Session 2 <[[https://more.flywire.com/Webinar_NewClientDashboardAPACQASession.html]]>: May 20th at 10am SGT, HKT, MST | 11am KST | 12pm AEST | 2pm NZST
If you’re unable to join one of our Q&A sessions, simply log in to our Help Center <[[https://help.client.flywire.com/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> for additional resources, or contact your Relationship Manager with any questions.
